name: Blind Sight
source:
You play as Anthony, a university student unwittingly drawn into a web of dark secrets and malevolent forces that plague his campus. Your choices will shape Anthony's fate as he navigates an eerie encounter and uncovers the university's sinister past. 

With the help of a mysterious artifact, Anthony has a chance to combat the threats that lurk in the shadows. Will you lead him to safety, or will he succumb to the darkness?

[From [url=https://elitheslime.itch.io/blind-sight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演安东尼，一名大学生，无意中陷入了困扰校园的黑暗秘密和邪恶势力的网络。你的选择将决定安东尼的命运，因为他将经历一场怪异的遭遇并揭开大学险恶的过去。

在神秘神器的帮助下，安东尼有机会对抗潜伏在阴影中的威胁。你会带他到安全的地方，还是他会屈服于黑暗？

[来自[url=https://elitheslime.itch.io/blind-sight]Itch.io[/url]]
